description: Two machines independently record the same value, in their own words. That is corroboration, not a conflict, and it is reported as a count rather than a warning - a warning here would train people to ignore warnings. Whether two members are one claim or several is decided by content and never by the value key (FR-327, D77), which is what separates this case from its identical-content sibling below.

proposals.content: We run Postgres for everything durable
